why: This batch stages member-made CS:GO fakes and also works out whether jokes and leaks are real, so the gate turns on who staged the claim being judged.

why.T3-009: Members mark their own finished r/place work as achieved (high fives, congratulations, the final result) rather than beating a named rival, which keeps it from T3-154.

why.T3-020: The bare title signals an opportunity (a spot/opening) on the canvas, so it belongs with choosing a canvas spot rather than with T3-036's judgement that the canvas is full.

why.T3-016: Members ask and answer what r/place is and how placing works, explaining the event for newcomers rather than posting the room's own coordinates or template (T3-070).

why.T3-048: Members anticipate, receive and reveal the 1RIT April Fools joke as a known joke, reacting to it rather than still testing whether it is real (T3-095).

why.T3-038: The bulk turns selected images into pixels and reports their state (starts, placements, progress, corrections), so the mark is being built and reported; the material also carries T3-002 (open calls for hands), T3-033 (proposals of what to make) and T3-004 (design/scale arguments), each with three or more concepts of its own.

why.T3-065: The work being recruited for, placed and defended is El Salvador's own flag, so the flag theme governs the calls for hands to it rather than the generic T3-002.

why.T3-010: The passages settle lines, hearts and shared space between neighbouring rooms (offers, acceptances, letting the heart stay, sharing with Nicaragua) rather than pleading with attackers (T3-139) or asking a host for space (T3-035).

why.T3-017: Ordinary sub business (news, reading, francophonie, recurring formats) goes on fitted around the pixel work, not the room's running in-joke (T3-031).
why.T3-037: Beyond that, members judge the canvas itself stupid or useless and wish the effort had served something concrete, which is the canvas's worth argued.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-017's gate only reaches ordinary talk going on around the canvas; it does not carry the members' verdicts that the canvas itself is stupid or useless.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0183610 calls it all stupid, C0524421 calls r/place useless and C1409910 wishes the coordination had served something concrete, so the canvas's worth is argued.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-037; dropping it loses only the bare worth-judgements, while the ordinary-life fitting is the bulk.

why.T3-043: Members thank and credit those who helped the flag effort (a joiner, and r/placehearts for the canvas), crediting help rather than telling an alliance's story as T3-072 would.

why.T3-032: Members call the April Fools jokes unfunny, annoying, too early or worth removing and ask for them to go, objecting to the sub's jokes rather than playing inside a staged change (T3-023).

why.T3-009: The same assembling of praise, congratulations and the final result marks the room's own finished work as achieved, not a rival defeated (T3-154).

why.T3-001: Members post their own fake CS:GO updates, skins, roster moves and leaks as if true and others fall for or reveal them, so the room staged the claim rather than testing an outside one (T3-095).

why.T3-117: The bare reaction to returning after a weekend offline faces the state of the canvas window rather than the room's own lost work mourned (T3-029) or the sub's subject going on (T3-017).

why.T3-023: Members play inside the moderators' Overwatch restyling of the whole sub, renaming weapons and posting in character, rather than staging fakes of their own (T3-001) or objecting (T3-032).

why.T3-033: Members offer the room ideas for what to put on the canvas (a signature, the CS mark, 'Crisp Clean Lock Bois'), proposing the room's mark before any call to hands.
why.T3-002: Beyond that, plain calls send members to come and place for the mark already mooted, which the proposing theme does not itself carry.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-033's gate only reaches an idea of what to make offered to the room; it does not carry the bare calls for hands to come and place once a mark is mooted.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0006484 ('Come to help!'), C0910601 ('Build our sub in /r/place!') and C0780638 ('coordinate and contribute') are calls to the room's own members to come and place, with no new idea of what to make.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-002; dropping it loses the recruiting calls, while the proposing of a signature is the theme's centre.
